site.lead: Hi, it’s EMM. I’m a Design Generalist, specialising in Brand Design.
about: Brand identities, logos, websites, posters and social graphics, for clients and for my own brands.
Emmency is my studio. The House of EMM is where my own brands live.

original.tag: Original · the client's site, not my design

brands.title: Fleur
brands.blurb: Identity for Fleur, a beauty and bridal makeup brand: wordmark with its asterisk bloom, flower icon, colour palette, moodboard and launch posts.

brands.title: Devil's Draught
brands.blurb: A dark craft beer with two editions, Hell and Death by Ice. Wordmark, pattern, cans, bottles and packaging. Crafted in darkness, savored in shadows.

brands.title: Chloe Mitchell
brands.blurb: A personal brand for an author elevating women in business: script wordmark, CM monogram, stationery, and the launch of her book, The Undefeated Spirit.

brands.title: Realm
brands.blurb: An identity for a headphone company: a quiet wordmark with a split-arch symbol, shown on product and campaign imagery.

brands.title: Burger Streat
brands.blurb: A smash-burger brand pitch: bold bun mark, warm orange palette, pattern and storefront. Juiciest and fattest smash burgers on the planet.

brands.title: Alchemmy
brands.blurb: A studio for designing brands and creatives. A four-point star that turns into badges, boxes and a rendered dream.

brands.title: X, reworked
brands.blurb: A self-initiated rework of X: a sharper letterform, an X Plus tier, and motion studies.

brands.title: Noxrmen
